laugh_wag.desc: beak up (-0.55 held), the head wags +-0.45 on every other ha, a small bow pulse (+0.10) on every ha shakes the body

laugh_bob.desc: beak up, small wag (+-0.25); the body bobs on every ha and the head pumps back further on each ha (head_pitch -0.4 -> -0.7)

laugh_roll.desc: beak up (-0.55), the head rolls side to side (+-0.35 asked) on every other ha, the body bobs on every ha

renders.desc: seven short staccato synth quacks, each a little lower: 'ha-ha-ha-ha, ha-ha-ha'
the bank's own chirps, chopped to 0.12 s, from the highest to the lowest: a staccato run in the real voice
a short rising giggle glide, the staccato run, then the last ha stretched into a falling 'haaa'
